svg.title: The climb: Cave painting
svg.desc: The climb (2D): a side-on shaft painted on rock in ochre and charcoal, with hand stencils blown around it. At a ledge too high for one, a brother braces at the foot while the brother above reaches down and pulls the next one up on the beat. Finger-dot holds zigzag upward, firm ones ringed; light grows at the top and the rock warms from blue to red. Tally strokes count the lifts.
